game-intro: Join the numbers and get to the 2048 tile!
game-explanation: Use your arrow keys to move the tiles. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one!
copy-warning: <note>Note:</note> This site is <emph>not</emph> the official version of 2048, but it only differs in translation strings. You can play the official version on your phone via <official-site>http://git.io/2048.</official-site> All other apps or sites are derivatives (such as this one) or fakes, and should be used with caution.
created-by: Created by <author>Gabriele Cirulli.</author> Based on <source>1024 by Veewo Studio</source> and conceptually similar to <inspiration>Threes by Asher Vollmer.</inspiration>
